messages:
lucy: Heads up 9: planning to change routing policy that assigns requests to pricing tiers based on X-Route-Tag precedence. Current behavior: first-seen tag wins. Proposed: deterministic precedence list + normalized tag keys. Goal: reduce duplicate attribution and quota churn. Shadow run for 10d then canary. thoughts?

pranav: Why deterministic precedence instead of last-write wins? Some clients rely on the earlier SDK writing team:<name> after tenant:<id>. Also, how does this affect per-route quotas?

lucy: precedence order would be explicit: tenant > team > env. So tenant:id overrides team if both present. We think it matches billing intent.

tessa: Dashboard/preview implications: invoice preview joins on route_tag; normalization will change keys (lowercase, drop whitespace). That will cause preview mismatches. We need a preview mode to compute using both old and new keys side-by-side.

mike: Telemetry spec: emit meter.route.normalize_version = "v1->v2-2026-03" and meter.route.choice_reason enum (explicit_tenant, fallback_team, missing_tag). Also add meter.route.hash to make shard-level comparisons cheap.

billing-bot: job:shadower started at 6980013000 sample=100% read-shadow=no-ledger-writes.

pranav: Gate questions: what thresholds for invoice diffs do we allow per-tenant? last migration had surprises.

lucy: Proposal: nightly-recon compares preview totals across old vs new attribution. If tenant delta > 0.4% OR > $100 in 24h, hold that tenant out of canary.

mike: Add runtime flags: k.reroute.disable_precendence_override and k.recon.skip_tenants list for canary. Also, add a per-tenant deep-sample log that records raw incoming headers + normalized tag for 1k events/day.

pranav: SDKs: we'll add a compatibility shim so clients can send both X-Route-Tag and X-Tenant-Id; server should prefer explicit tenant key when present. Can we accept both for 60 days?

tessa: UI: building a console panel "Routing migration" that shows per-tenant preview delta, last-night delta trend, and a toggle to view old/new attribution in invoice preview. Need API from platform team that returns paired-preview rows. ETA: 4 days.

infra-oncall: Runbook: If nightly recon shows >0.6% delta for any tenant AND observed spike in meter.ingest.errors, page platform@ and flip k.reroute to old behavior for affected shards. Include rollback command: `k8s annotate deployment/metering route-migration=disabled --namespace=prod`

lucy: One more operational detail: we must not retroactively rewrite ledger entries. Rewrites would break accounting. Any mismatched historical amounts go to a reconciliation queue for manual review. Auto credits disabled.

billing-bot: nightly-reconciler finished at 6980014500. top-deltas: tenant:novus 0.52% (flagged), tenant:open-sky 0.12%.

pranav: novus flagged 9. hold them out of canary and open ticket to investigate alias mapping. I'll PR alias normalization rules.

mike: I'll add the meter.route.* metrics to dashboards and create an alert: meter.recon.invoice_delta_percent > 0.5% for 2 consecutive runs -> critical.

tessa: I'll wire the console toggle and expose per-tenant sample logs for support.

lucy: rollout plan summary in-line:
- Day 0: enable shadow (read-only to new codepath)
- Days 1-10: nightly recon + console surfacing + flag-driven opt-outs
- Day 10+: enable 2% canary writes for tenants that pass recon for last 3 nights
- Ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 72h with gating based on metrics

pranav: Agree. Follow-ups: @mike add metrics, @tessa console panel, @lucy PR for kflags and rollout k8s job, @pranav alias map PR. We'll sync after first-night report. :thumbsup:
